step_by_step_procedure: Line Segment: Straight path connecting two endpoints.
Ray: Starts at endpoint and extends infinitely in one direction.
Line: Extends infinitely in two opposite directions.
formulas_and_identities: Unique line property: Exactly 1 line passes through 2 distinct points.
sub_branches.example_problem: How many lines pass through 1 point? Answer: Infinitely many.

step_by_step_procedure: Multiply fractional turn by 360° to find degree measure.
formulas_and_identities: Degree Angle = Fraction of Turn x 360°

step_by_step_procedure: Compare angle measure theta against 90°, 180°, and 360°.
Fold straight line crease onto itself to form perpendicular meeting at four 90° right angles.
Fold angle arms onto each other to form angle bisector (halving the angle).
sub_branches.example_problem: Bisect a 90° angle. Answer: Two 45° angles.
